top_signals.title: Japan’s Nikkei Poised to Enter Bear Market as AI Selloff Deepens
top_signals.summary: Japan’s Nikkei 225 Stock Average slumped Friday, putting the tech-heavy gauge on course to enter a technical bear market as investors unwind artificial intelligence-related trades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
